datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The bijie landslide dataset (Ji et al. 2020) includes 770 labeled samples extracted from the TripleSat satellite images, showcasing a diverse array of landslide types.

methods.name: ETGC2-Net
methods.summary: An enhanced Transformer and graph convolution combined network that integrates an EFormer (Inverted Transformer + CBAM) for feature extraction, a SIEM for spatial information enhancement, and a superpixel-guided GCN (SGCN) to model spatial topology.
methods.source: Shuaishuai Fan, Yibin Fu, Weiming Li, Hongyang Bai, Yonghua Jiang
methods.verbatim: With the aforementioned considerations, we propose an enhanced Transformer and graph convolution combined network, namely ETGC2-Net, which can efficiently compute on original satellite images and accurately identifies landslide areas.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with indication of datasets, no shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is mentioned but not linked, and the custom ETGC2-Net code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
